free_design.Place: A bright orbital hotel breakfast nook with cream banquette seating, a silver tabletop and flat cool white ceiling light.
free_design.Activity: She is quietly leveling a stack of toast onto a small plate, leaning forward so the scalloped neckline of her lounge top becomes visible below the edge of her jacket.
free_design.Pose: Seated upright in a three-quarter front view, with the torso leaning slightly from the waist. Her right forearm extends to rest her fingertips near the edge of the plate, while her left hand holds the handle of a plain teaspoon. Both wrists and elbows remain separate and visible.
free_design.Framing: Portrait 2:3, eye-level waist-up composition with both hands and the table in view.
free_design.Outfit: An opaque periwinkle lingerie-inspired lounge top with scalloped neckline panels, high-waisted navy sateen lounge shorts, and an open cropped linen jacket. The forward reach turns the top neckline toward the light while the lined fabric stays securely in place.
